WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    (s.gbsize / s.spanmin) as rate
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL 
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL 
    AND s.spanmin > 0
),
group_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(rate) as group_rate
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_rate) as benchmark_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT 
  gr.arcref,
  gr.fundflux,
  gr.group_rate,
  (gr.group_rate - b.benchmark_rate) as excess
FROM group_rates gr, benchmark b
WHERE gr.group_rate > b.benchmark_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10
